content:
**Glow Sight** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increasing damage to glowing enemies.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Deal +60% damage to Glowing Enemies. | 00393F64 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Deal +40% damage to Glowing Enemies. | 00393F63 | 
| ★ | 1 | Deal +20% damage to Glowing Enemies. | 00393F62 | 

The irradiated feral ghouls fought throughout the entirety of the public event Radiation Rumble are affected by this perk.
